title: Attain the sharp nonreciprocal Clifford correction rank
body:
PR1920 proves that sixteen same-direction rank-one lanes require a left correction with rank(F-I) at least six after any reciprocal encoding of one phased rank-five Clifford child, but does not attain six. This package closes that gap with six explicit nilpotent rank-one linear shears and complete 32-dimensional Gaussian-rational encoding/correction matrices.

The same construction proves the sharp phase-specific minimum max(m_-1,m_-i) for every power-of-two lane count and both child directions. Optimizing phase gives 2^(s-1) for odd s and 2^(s-1)-2^((s-2)/2) for even s>=2 (zero at s=0). The proof pairs unwanted eigenspaces and corrects unmatched singletons; the predecessor eigenmultiplicity lower bound matches exactly. It keeps all inputs arbitrary, with square invertible maps and no discarded outputs.

This is an algebraic correction-rank optimum, not six native ADDs or six recursive children. Tensoring with an unchanged spectator multiplies correction rank. Encoding, physical linear reads/writes, frames, storage, routing, precision and restoration remain unpriced; under PR679's joined-volume upper expression even a free adapter loses. No physical construction-gate success, supplier, or new kappa is claimed.

Validation on native CPython 3.12.14: the registered package passes 1032 spectral cases, 48 complete operators through dimension 64, 10,920 pinned native kernel entries, exact receipt reconstruction and semantic controls. A code-separated dense Gaussian-rational checker verifies every 32-dimensional identity entry, invertibility, rank 6, the six outer products, nilpotence and spectator scaling. Four integration tests pass normal/optimized Git-free read-only export, fail-before-execution source corruption, typed receipt and scientific-witness corruption, missing evidence, exact regeneration and exclusive output. A separate AI reviewer checked the proof/code and independently reran both engines under optimized Python 3.12.7 without a blocker. Selected baseline bindings and whitespace checks pass. No hosted CI, formal proof kernel, independent human review or full selected cold replay is claimed.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clifford-sharp-correction-rank
```

Canonical main was freshly fetched at start, pivot and submission, unchanged at 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2 (priority 4). Exact PR1920 head 057b214aea45c65926b93ad8b95693c80f0f79c9 was fetched and its README blob matches the pinned input. Final overlap covers 710 open PR bodies; GraphQL rate limits leave Discussions at the explicitly timestamped last complete 1,192-record snapshot, not a current census. Only this scoped package is added.
